people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.
translations.bsb: So the decree went out that the wise men were to be executed, and men went to look for Daniel and his friends to execute them.
translations.kjv: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
translations.asv: So the decree went forth, and the wise men were to be slain; and they sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.
